title: [human] heft SSH host key changed - verify new fingerprint before fleet use
description: Blocking all needs-linux/heft-routed work as of this round. ssh heft now fails host-key verification: known_hosts pins an ECDSA key (line 9) but heft presents ED25519 SHA256:ULf+qe2xaWB68fSsfH469kCWrFfd4ew815FuHkeWrjo. Plausibly benign (heft reimaged/ssh regenerated) but must be verified by Mark against the box directly before any worker removes the old entry (ssh-keygen -R heft + re-accept). Do NOT have agents self-approve the new key. Until resolved, heft-routed beads need the AWS pinned builder instead.
close_reason: Moot: the interactive session now runs on heft natively — no SSH from the Mac to heft remains in the workflow. Host-key change is irrelevant to fleet operations.
